name: Boku no Kanojo wa Gatenkei/Kanojo ga Shita Koto, Boku ga Sareta Koto/Kyonyuu Tsuma Kanzen Hokaku Keikaku/Boku no Tsuma ga Aitsu ni Netoraremashita.
original_name: ボクの彼女はガテン系/彼女がした事、僕がされた事/巨乳妻完全捕獲計画/ボクの妻がアイツに寝取られました。
source:
The year of 2012, late autumn. Tanaka Masashi, an architect, and Tanaka Misaki, a beautician, are in their third year of marriage. Masashi is invited with his wife on a friendship trip to an onsen by Aida, an executive director of the construction company, a frequent business partner of Masashi's firm.
Laying in the open-air bath with Misaki, Masashi starts recalling the beginning of their love.

The year of 2006. Masashi spends his time working in a convenience store three days a week. He is a 19 year old part-time worker. Being at a loss because of a sudden breakdown of the only source of amusement in his room, a television, he is recruited against his will by Aida to work on the construction site. And there he encounters Kaitou Misaki, the 19 year old chief of his team.

The year of 2016. During the time when Misaki starts systematically being late in her way from work, Masashi finds an unexpected item in his own bedroom. Moreover, Misaki suddenly shuts down her beauty salon, although it was doing well, and gets a job at Aida's construction company.
In late autumn, Tanaka wakes up in the middle of the night at a hot spring inn where he went on a friendship trip, just as he did four years ago, and witnesses an unbelievable scene.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1080795]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
2012年深秋。建筑设计师田中正志与美容师田中美咲已经结婚三年。经常与正志所在事务所合作的建筑公司专务相田，邀请夫妻二人一同参加温泉联谊旅行。
正志与美咲泡在露天浴池里，开始回忆两人恋情的起点。

2006年。19岁的正志是一名自由职业者，每周有三天在便利店打工。房间里唯一的娱乐——电视——突然坏掉，正志正一筹莫展，却被相田强行拉去建筑工地工作，并在那里遇见了19岁的班组长海藤美咲。

2016年。美咲下班回家的时间开始一再推迟，正志又在自家卧室里发现了一件意想不到的物品。不仅如此，原本经营顺利的美咲突然关闭美容院，转而进入相田的建筑公司工作。
深秋时节，田中在温泉旅馆参加与四年前相同的联谊旅行。他于半夜醒来，亲眼目睹了一幕难以置信的景象。

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1080795]Getchu[/url]]
